ideas.title: The Politicization of the Justice Department
ideas.description: Investigate the extent to which the Justice Department's investigations are being influenced by political considerations.
questions: What are the implications of a politicized Justice Department for the rule of law?
How can the independence of the Justice Department be ensured?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant wrongdoing and shed light on the inner workings of the Justice Department. By following the money and investigating the connections between politicians and the Justice Department, we may uncover a larger pattern of corruption.
